versions.changelog:
Minor update to resolve version conflict with ClawHub.

- Version bumped to 1.0.1 to avoid submission/versioning conflict.
- No functional or documentation changes.
- Existing orchestration of 9 runtime-safety sub-skills remains unchanged.

1.0.0: Initial release of PromptShield / ai-safety-suite — a bilingual orchestration skill for agent runtime safety.

- Orchestrates 9 independently published sub-skills (by slug) to cover red-team drill, prompt injection defense, leak scanning, runtime call guards, and skill admission gating.
- Provides a CLI interface to list lifecycle stages and route users to the appropriate sub-skill and usage instructions.
- No sub-skill code is bundled; references and routes to existing, separately maintained skills.
- Includes detailed documentation in both English and Chinese, with lifecycle diagrams, evidence bars, and usage demos.
- Read-only, documentation-focused, and does not access or process business data.
